name: buffer
summary: A Node.js-compatible implementation of the core `buffer` module
description:
Titanium provides a number of shims and ports of core Node.js module functionality.

This module is intended to provide a Node-compatible port of the `buffer`.

More details on the Node.js API can be found in their [buffer module documentation](https://nodejs.org/api/buffer.html)

properties.name: INSPECT_MAX_BYTES
properties.summary: The maximum number of bytes that will be returned when `buf.inspect()` is called. This can be overridden by user modules.

properties.name: kMaxLength
properties.summary: The largest size allowed for a single [buffer.Buffer](api:buffer.Buffer) instance.

properties.name: poolSize
properties.summary: This is the size (in bytes) of pre-allocated internal `Buffer` instances used for pooling. This value may be modified.

methods.name: alloc
methods.summary: Allocates a new `Buffer` of `size` bytes. If `fill` is `undefined`, the `Buffer` will be zero-filled.

parameters.name: size
parameters.summary: The desired length of the new `Buffer`.

parameters.name: fill
parameters.summary: A value to pre-fill the new `Buffer` with.

parameters.name: encoding
parameters.summary: If `fill` is a string, this is its encoding.

parameters.name: size
parameters.summary: The desired length of the new `Buffer`.

parameters.name: size
parameters.summary: The desired length of the new `Buffer`.

methods.name: byteLength
methods.summary: Returns the byte length of a string when encoded using `encoding`. This is not the same as `String.prototype.length`, which does not account for the encoding that is used to convert the string into bytes.

parameters.name: string
parameters.summary: A value to calculate the length of.

parameters.name: encoding
parameters.summary: If `string` is a string, this is its encoding.

methods.name: compare
methods.summary: Compares `buf1` to `buf2`, typically for the purpose of sorting arrays of [buffer.Buffer](api:buffer.Buffer) instances. This is equivalent to calling `buf1.compare(buf2)`.

parameters.name: buf1
parameters.summary: A value to calculate the length of.

parameters.name: buf2
parameters.summary: If `string` is a string, this is its encoding.

returns.summary: Either `-1`, `0`, or `1`, depending on the result of the comparison. See [buffer.Buffer.compare](api:buffer.Buffer#compare) for details.

methods.name: concat
methods.summary:
Returns a new [buffer.Buffer](api:buffer.Buffer) which is the result of concatenating all the [buffer.Buffer](api:buffer.Buffer) instances in the list together.

If the list has no items, or if the `totalLength` is `0`, then a new zero-length Buffer is returned.

parameters.name: list
parameters.summary: List of `Buffer` or `Uint8Array` instances to concatenate.

parameters.name: totalLength
parameters.summary: Total length of the Buffer instances in list when concatenated.

returns.summary: Either `-1`, `0`, or `1`, depending on the result of the comparison. See [buffer.Buffer.compare](api:buffer.Buffer#compare) for details.

methods.name: from
methods.summary: Allocates a new `Buffer` using an `array` of bytes in the range `0 – 255`. Array entries outside that range will be truncated to fit into it.

parameters.name: arg
parameters.summary: The array of bytes to wrap in a `Buffer`, `Buffer` to copy, String to decode into bytes, or [Titanium.Buffer](api:Titanium.Buffer) to wrap.

parameters.name: encodingOrOffset
parameters.summary: encoding of the string, or start offset of array/buffer

parameters.name: length
parameters.summary: length of the underlying array/buffer to wrap

parameters.name: obj
parameters.summary: The object to check if it is a `Buffer`

methods.name: isEncoding
methods.summary: Returns `true` if `encoding` is the name of a supported character encoding, or `false` otherwise.

parameters.name: encoding
parameters.summary: A character encoding name to check.
